ethnarch.definition: n. the ruler of a province (as in the Roman Empire and Byzantine Empire) or certain religious rulers with secular authority
ethnarch.translation: n. 行政长官, 总督, (种族、部落的)首领

ethnarchy.definition: n. The dominion of an ethnarch; principality and rule.
ethnarchy.translation: n. 总督的职位, 总督的身份

ethnic.definition: n. a person who is a member of an ethnic group
ethnic.translation:
a. 人种的, 种族的
[医] 人种的

ethnic slur.translation: [网络] 种族蔑称；人种的歧视；人种的污蔑

ethnical.definition: s denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
ethnical.translation: a. 种族的, 异教徒的, 人种学的

ethnically.translation: adv. 人种上, 民族上

ethnicism.translation: n. 种族集团划分; 异教信仰; 异教; 种族认同, 强调种族特性

ethnicities.definition:
plural of ethnicity
n. an ethnic quality or affiliation resulting from racial or cultural ties
ethnicities.translation: (ethnicity 的复数) n. 种族划分

ethnicity.definition: n. an ethnic quality or affiliation resulting from racial or cultural ties

ethnics.definition: n a person who is a member of an ethnic group
ethnics.translation:
n. 伦理学, 人种学
[医] 人种学

ethno-.translation: [前缀]表示“种族, 民族”之义

ethnoarchaeology.translation: n. 种族文化考古学,文化群落考古学

ethnobiologist.translation: n. 人种生物学家（一门研究原始人类社会与其环境的动植物间关系的学科） (ethnobiology的变形)

ethnobiology.translation: n. 人种生物学( 一门研究原始人类社会与其环境的动植物间关系的学科)

ethnocentric.definition: a. centered on a specific ethnic group, usually one's own
ethnocentric.translation: 种族[民族]中心主义的, 种族[民族, 集团]优越感的

ethnocentrism.definition: n. belief in the superiority of one's own ethnic group

ethnocide.translation: n. 种族文化灭绝(指对某一种族集团文化的肆意破坏)

ethnogenesis.translation: n. 人种形成, 种族进化

ethnogeny.translation: n. 人种起源学, 人种学

ethnographer.definition: n. an anthropologist who does ethnography
ethnographer.translation: n. 人种志学者, 人种学者

ethnographers.definition:
plural of ethnographer
n. an anthropologist who does ethnography
ethnographers.translation: (ethnographer 的复数) n. 人种志学者, 人种学者

ethnographic.definition: a. of or relating to ethnography

ethnographical.definition: a of or relating to ethnography

ethnographies.definition:
plural of ethnography
n. the branch of anthropology that provides scientific description of individual human societies
ethnographies.translation:
(ethnography 的复数) n. 人种论, 人种学
[医] 人种志

ethnography.definition: n. the branch of anthropology that provides scientific description of individual human societies
ethnography.translation:
n. 人种论, 人种学
[医] 人种志

ethnolinguist.translation: n. 人类文化语言学者, 民族学派语言学者

ethnologic.definition: a of or relating to ethnology

ethnological.definition: a. of or relating to ethnology
ethnological.translation: a. 民族的, 人种学的

ethnologically.definition:
adv. In an ethnological manner; by ethnological
   classification; as, one belonging ethnologically to an African race.

ethnologist.definition: n. an anthropologist who studies ethnology
ethnologist.translation: n. 民族学者, 人种学者

ethnologists.definition:
plural of ethnologist
n. an anthropologist who studies ethnology
ethnologists.translation: (ethnologist 的复数) n. 民族学者, 人种学者

ethnology.definition: n. the branch of anthropology that deals with the division of humankind into races and with their origins and distribution and distinctive characteristics
ethnology.translation:
n. 人种学
[医] 人种学

ethnomethodologist.translation: n. 民族方法学家 (ethnomethodology的变形)

ethnomethodologists.translation: (ethnomethodologist 的复数) n. 民族方法学家 (ethnomethodology的变形)

ethnomethodology.translation: n. 民族方法学(社会学的一分支学科)

ethnomusicologists.translation: (ethnomusicologist 的复数) n. 人种音乐学

ethnomycology.translation: n. 民族真菌学( 研究各社会中对致幻蘑菇及其他真菌的使用)

ethnopoetics.translation: [网络] 民族志诗学；民族诗学；民族学诗学

ethnopsychology.translation:
n. 民族心理学
[医] 人种心理学

ethnos.definition: n people of the same race or nationality who share a distinctive culture
ethnos.translation: n. (=ethnic group)同种同文化之民族

ethnoscience.translation: 原始人(关于动物分类等)的自然知识
